title: without a usable JITSO_PROJECT the guard cannot know the primary worktree and denies a line that holds --worktree
source: intended: docs/decisions.md A2 (defect N-23): the guard fails closed when the primary is unknown
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-23, owner answer A2). The primary worktree comes from JITSO_PROJECT, which the dispatcher sets for its claude. A line that holds --worktree is denied with a reason of its own when the variable is empty or does not name a git checkout, instead of being compared with nothing. The TS binary denies the line for another reason (it does not allow --build), so the reason text FAILS on TS.

reason.equals: JITSO dispatch guard: JITSO_PROJECT is not set, so the primary worktree is unknown
JITSO dispatch guard: JITSO_PROJECT does not name a git checkout
